name: The High Wilderness
label: Quest
description: Angelas Moonbreeze and Troyas look into old ruins in the forests of Feralas, yet lately Troyas goes alone to the High Wilderness, which worries Angelas.…
intro: Angelas Moonbreeze and Troyas look into old ruins in the forests of Feralas, yet lately Troyas goes alone to the High Wilderness, which worries Angelas. Gordunni ogres hold that ground. Angelas hopes you will make the ruins to the southeast a little safer by culling the ogres.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although it is dangerous, Troyas and I have been investigating the ruins that cover the forests of Feralas.

Lately, though, Troyas has been going on his own to the High Wilderness, and I really worry about him. The Gordunni Ogres have taken over that area, and they don't take kindly to anyone that enters their territory.
I was hoping you might be willing to travel to the ruins to the southeast and clear out some of the ogres. Make it a little safer for my Troyas, and I will be extremely grateful.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Be watchful around the Gordunni, friend. Their magic seems to wreak havoc on the very land they stand on.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am very grateful you were able to do this for me.
Now, please, don't mention a word to Troyas about this...
